convertibility_reason: Uses partial close / scale-out logic which adds complexity. Also has conditional SL/TP (fixed vs ATR-based dynamic), conditional position sizing (fixed vs risk-based auto), and session time filtering. While indicators are built-in (RSI, ATR), the multi-mode SL/TP/sizing and partial close logic require careful manual conversion.

derived_values.name: CurrentSignal - RSI value at bar index 1 (previous completed bar)
PreviousSignal - RSI value at bar index 2 (two bars ago)
derived_values.used_by: Crossover/crossunder detection for entry and exit

derived_values.name: CurrentVolatility - ATR value at bar index 1
derived_values.used_by: Not directly used in current logic (PreviousVolatility is used instead)

derived_values.name: PreviousVolatility - ATR value at bar index 0 (current bar ATR)
derived_values.used_by: Dynamic SL/TP calculation and scale-out threshold

params.mode: conditional: SL_FIXED=0 disables SL; SL_FIXED>0=FixedStopLoss pips; SL_AUTO=ATR*VolatilityFactorSL
conditional: TP_FIXED=0 disables TP; TP_FIXED>0=FixedTakeProfit pips; TP_AUTO=ATR*VolatilityFactorTP

other_exits: Partial close (scale-out): When price moves in favor by ATR*VolatilityFactorSO, close ScaleOutPercent% of position. Only triggered once per position (checks deal history for prior partial close).

params.mode: RISK_DEFAULT_FIXED=fixed lots at FixedLotSize; RISK_DEFAULT_AUTO=risk-based sizing using RiskPercentage of RiskCalculationBase / (SL_pips * tick_value)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: PositionSizeMode=RISK_DEFAULT_FIXED uses FixedLotSize (0.1). PositionSizeMode=RISK_DEFAULT_AUTO calculates volume = (RiskBase * RiskPercentage/100) / (StopLossPoints * TickValue). Falls back to FixedLotSize when SL=0.

custom_logic_notes: RSI data is read from bars [1] and [2] (previous completed bars), not bar [0], so signals are based on confirmed closed-bar values. The new_bar_guard allows first tick of a new bar only (new_bar_ticks<=1). Exit conditions reuse the same RSI crossover logic as entry: RSI crossing above LowerThreshold closes shorts, RSI crossing below UpperThreshold closes longs. Scale-out checks deal history to ensure partial close only happens once per position. MaxSpreadAllowed parameter exists but is never checked in the trading logic - appears to be an unused input. The MagicNumber filter for closing positions has a bug: when IdentificationNumber=0, the filter 'IdentificationNumber!=0 && PositionMagic!=IdentificationNumber' always passes, so it closes ALL positions for the symbol regardless of magic number.
python_conversion_notes: 1) The conditional SL/TP modes (fixed pips vs ATR dynamic) need dual implementation paths. 2) Scale-out (partial close) logic requires deal history tracking to prevent double-scaling - in Python backtest, use a per-position flag instead. 3) Position sizing has two modes: fixed lot and risk-based auto sizing - implement both with conditional switching. 4) RSI signal uses bar[1] and bar[2] (previous two completed bars) for crossover detection, not the current forming bar - ensure shift indices are correct. 5) The new_bar_guard implementation in Python should compare current bar timestamp with previous. 6) Session time filter uses server time (TimeCurrent), not local time. 7) Note: MaxSpreadAllowed input exists but is NOT enforced in any trading logic - can be ignored or implemented as enhancement. 8) The LoadIndicatorData retry loop with Sleep() is MT5-specific; in Python backtesting, indicator data is always available from arrays.
